name: B4GALT7
summary: B4GALT7, Friesian dwarfism - the one disorder in the mod a horse lives with: reduced scale and health, but survivable. Recessive; wild horses carry it but are never affected.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Two working copies. Nothing is wrong and nothing is passed on.

phenotypes.name: B4GALT7 carrier
phenotypes.description: One copy of d. The horse is completely normal and there is no way to see it - but half its foals inherit the copy, and two carriers bred together are the only way friesian dwarfism appears.

phenotypes.name: Friesian dwarfism
phenotypes.description: Short, splayed limbs and a weak ribcage on a normal-sized head. The horse lives, but it is small, slow, jumps badly and has noticeably fewer hearts.
